name: toast-stack
title: Toast stack
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Stacks short results at the edge until they are dismissed. An undo appearance is a dark pill that pauses on hover.

meta.descriptionEs: Apila resultados cortos en el borde hasta que se descartan.

examples.description: Apila resultados cortos en el borde hasta que se descartan.

docs: Adapted from Arc UI (MIT). Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion.
